projects.name: DA VINCI TOWER
projects.description: DA VINCI TOWER, INTERIORS BY PAGANI features a 19-story structure with 2- to 4-bedroom apartments and penthouses, luxury finishes inspired by the Pagani brand. Amenities include an infinity pool, premium gym, spa, social lounge, 24/7 security, covered parking, and green spaces with terraces, combining luxury design with modern conveniences.

projects.name: DG1 Livinig
projects.description: DG1 Living in Dubai offers a 20-story building with 1, 2, and 3-bedroom units featuring modern finishes. Amenities include a pool, gym, spa, social lounge, children’s play area, 24/7 security, underground parking, and green outdoor spaces, providing a comfortable and convenient living experience.

projects.name: Golf Gate 2
projects.description: Golf Gate 2 is a 14-story residential, offering 1 and 2-bedroom apartments with modern designs and premium finishes. It features contemporary architecture and open-plan layouts. Amenities include a landscaped garden, community pool, and fully equipped gym, providing residents with luxury, comfort, and convenience.

projects.name: Damac Casa
projects.description: Damac Casa is a 46-story luxury residential tower with 1- to 5-bedrooms stylish apartments and modern interiors. Amenities include a grand lobby, infinity pool, fitness center, landscaped gardens, concierge service, and secure parking. Spacious layouts, high-end finishes, and large windows maximize natural light and marina views, offering an elegant experience.

projects.name: Mercedes-Benz Places
projects.description: Mercedes-Benz Places is a 71-story, 341-meter-tall tower with 150 luxury residences, including 2- to 3-bedroom apartments and 4- to 5-bedroom penthouses. Amenities include a pool, gym, spa, parks, sports courts, retail stores, and secure parking. With opulent interiors and top-tier facilities, it offers a refined urban lifestyle.

projects.name: Six Senses Residences
projects.description: Six Senses Residences offers luxury living with a spa, pools, gym, dining, and outdoor areas. Its modern, sustainable design includes elegant 2- to 5-bedroom apartments and villas with high-end finishes, equipped kitchens, and lavish bathrooms. Rising 122 stories, it stands in one of Dubai’s most prestigious locations.

projects.name: Orla Dorchester Collection
projects.description: ORLA Dorchester Collection by Omniyat is a 13–14-storey beachfront development with 91 ultra-luxury units, including 2–4-bedroom residences, Sky Palaces, a Super Penthouse, and a Beach Mansion. Built by Innovo Build, it features design by Foster + Partners and interiors by Yodezeen. Amenities include a private beach, pools, spa, gym, cinema, lounge, bowling alley, and valet, with parking for 330 cars.

projects.name: Couture by Cavalli
projects.description: Couture is a 12-story luxury residence blending modern elegance with opulent style. Influenced by the renowned fashion brand, it features a sophisticated lobby, private pool, and high-end gym. Spacious 3 to 5-bedroom Apartments and 6 bedroom Penthouses boast open layouts, premium fittings, and large windows for natural light, offering comfort and exclusivity.

projects.name: ELO 2
projects.description: ELO 2 is a 14-story residential, offering 1 and 2-bedroom apartments with modern design and high-end finishes. Amenities include a swimming pool, fitness center, landscaped gardens, social lounge, children's play area, 24/7 security, and ample parking. Designed for contemporary living, ELO 2 offers style in a vibrant community.
